rules.description: Minimum paid annual leave: 20 working days; at least 3 additional working days for listed groups

source.title: European Commission EURES — Living and working conditions: Romania (Leave)

versions.notes: EURES (European Commission portal, national content): "each employee is entitled to paid annual leave for a minimum period of 20 days per year" and "Under the Labour Code, employees are entitled to a minimum annual leave of 20 working days"; "Employees working in harsh, dangerous or harmful conditions, persons with disabilities, blind persons and young people under the age of 18 are entitled to an additional annual leave of at least three days"; public holidays "are not included in the duration of the paid annual leave". The primary text (Codul muncii art. 145-147) could not be fetched (legislatie.just.ro, cdep.ro, gov.ro and mmuncii.ro refuse connections), so this EURES summary is the source until a person confirms it (HUMAN_TODO 3.2). effectiveFrom = verification date; earlier dates fall back to the EU baseline (4 weeks).
